description.value: The study investigated brain activations mediating and moderating PTSD symptom reduction during amygdala real-time fMRI neurofeedback emotional training in combat veterans with PTSD.

spans.text: The present study investigated brain activity mediators of the amygdala rtfMRI-nf training effect on combat veterans’ PTSD symptom reduction.

description.value: The study assigned participants to experimental or control neurofeedback groups; participants were blind to group assignment and completed seven visits with neurofeedback training at visits 3, 4, and 5.

spans.text: The study consisted of seven visits (on separate days) with an additional initial screening visit. RtfMRI-nf training was performed on the 3rd, 4th, and 5th visits.
Participants were blind to group assignment.

Modeling a mediation and moderation with SEM enables us to examine multiple direct and indirect effects of the neurofeedback training on symptom change while controlling other effects simultaneously.

model_representation_notes.value: Structural equation model mapping included direct, mediation, and moderation paths, with interaction factors and residual variances.
